about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for scouter.core.darkroom.no_wb_reroute_scope (htc-colorcal-rereview follow-up, decision rows 458/461's WB reroute guard). Each example is a call to no_wb_reroute_scope with the outcome a human calls right. Run by tests/intent/test_reroute_nested_intent.py.
subject: scouter/core/darkroom.py no_wb_reroute_scope + NO_WB_REROUTE

examples.source: the ordinary case: moves.adjust/moves.say entering their own reroute critical section once, with nothing else active

htc-colorcal-rereview: 'a nested cross-image reroute ... could inherit or clobber the flag' -- refused before the body runs rather than silently nesting; the already-active flag is left exactly as the outer call set it

cross-image case, end to end (tests/test_reroute_nested.py): image A's own adjust completes normally and NO_WB_REROUTE reads back False once A's own scope exits, even though a nested attempt for image B was refused partway through A's move
